topic.title: Life in Weeks Calculator
topic.description: Given an age, calculates remaining days, weeks, and months assuming a 90-year lifespan. Practices basic arithmetic and string output formatting.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Performing arithmetic operations on user input and displaying multiple results clearly.
learningNotes.challenges: Converting input string to integer before arithmetic.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Make the lifespan configurable and add years remaining.

files.description: Remaining days, weeks, and months calculator.
